title: Contract PR3042's four-ADD restore block to three
body:
## Summary

One exact contraction on both pinned PR3042 providers:

```diff
- restore: 212 gates; inverse cleanup: 5216 gates
+ restore: 211 gates; inverse cleanup: 5215 gates
  recursive paid profile, all frames, 408 helper widths and 91 buffers unchanged
```

The four-ADD block on registers 22/230 becomes three dyadic ADDs. Both implement `(x,y) -> (-y,x-y)`. The three-gate word is shortest in the stated two-register ADD/SCALE alphabet; its inverse is shortest too. The identity also holds for any common linear idempotent, so the proof covers the common-frame operation rather than scalar substitutions alone.

[Proof, exact sources, reproduction and limits](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e4acb6049a6c1897ad8d515892f67204ab1d8c0/research/rank7-restore-contraction/README.md). [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18982803).

This is a scalar-program improvement, **not a κ improvement or measured native speedup**. It is an explicitly labelled side result from the changed `complex-new-helper-inventory` scope, not a passed new-inventory/ceiling gate.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3042 `84cc406ad91ec53fff329a11a445d7effe564a77` has four ADDs at restore[175:179] and four inverse ADDs at cleanup[33:37].
  **After:** commit `9e4acb6049a6c1897ad8d515892f67204ab1d8c0` emits the contracted words after checking the complete audit. Exact 704-column restore equality, common-idempotent polynomial equality and the separate dirty private-buffer inverse identity pass for both providers.
- All 704 frame itineraries and the complete recursive invoice are unchanged. Six Git source bindings and all 21 committed package/input byte comparisons pass.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, 14 normal and optimized test groups, Python 3.13 receipt equality, source compilation and strict Ruff checks pass locally. The two-gate exclusions use symbolic coefficients, not a finite coefficient search. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-restore-contraction
```

Credit dcharb78 for PR3042, Jeremy Kothe for PR3015, Marius-Paul Dumitrean for PR2979, and the retained geometry/native/owner lineage. PR3050's finite-set frame checker is reused unchanged. Original notices remain. Development used substantial automated assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only a new research package and its opt-in replay are added. Frozen inputs, shared code and the selected frontier are unchanged. Native/compiler, ownership, physical backing/movement, precision/tape, all-size and outer admission are not rerun. Whether native lowering saves actual primitives remains the explicit next question; it is not assumed from the shorter scalar list.
